output_list.criticism: The output_list function returns an integer overflow, which has an integer input and an integer output, allowing an attacker to set the output to any value. This vulnerability can be exploited to cause a denial of service attack by setting the output to a large value. This can be mitigated by implementing proper input validation and limiting the maximum output value.

The setPrices function has an integer overflow, which allows an attacker to set the sellPrice and buyPrice to any value. This vulnerability can be exploited to manipulate the price of the token, leading to a loss of funds for the attacker. This can be mitigated by implementing proper input validation and limiting the maximum price value.
